title: ficus heterophylla f. scabrella
intro: Ficus heterophylla f. scabrella, commonly known as the Scabrella Ficus, is a species of fig tree that belongs to the family Moraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ficus heterophylla f. scabrella are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and possess anti-diarrheal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
